newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: VICOM in vehicle inspection venture.
newsitem.headline: VICOM in vehicle inspection venture.

text.p: Vehicle inspection company VICOM Ltd said on Thursday it had formed a joint venture company called VICOM Assessment Centre Pte Ltd (VAC) with four motor insurance partners.
VAC will assess the quality of post accident repairs to motor vehicles, VICOM said in a statement.
VICOM's partners in the deal are NTUC Income Insurance Co-operative Ltd, Cosmic Insurance Corp Ltd, Asia Insurance Co Ltd, and The People's Insurance Co Ltd.
The new venture is owned 51 percent by VICOM, 25 percent by NTUC Income, 10 percent by Cosmic, eight percent by Asia Insurance and six percent by People's Insurance.
